A task counts once, on the day of its last merge. 5 in 14 days Median spawn to merge i Median time from a task's first agent spawn to its merge. Tasks without a recorded spawn are left out. 4d 1h p90 spawn to merge i 90th percentile (nearest rank) of the same times: nine in ten tasks merged faster. 7d 2h Agents running now i Agents with a live pane right now: workers, team leads and HQ (boss, director, staff engineer). 6 4 workers · 0 leads · 2 HQ Unattended share i Merged tasks in the selected period with no owner involvement: no owner wait, no auto-merge block, no boss decision about the task. 3 of 5 Cost per merged PR i Average estimated API-equivalent cost of a merged PR at list prices as of 2026-10-25: the whole cost of each merged Claude-org task in the period (not cut to the period), divided by the tasks with a known cost. Tasks with no attributed tokens or no price are left out and counted. Cursor reports no tokens, so it has no cost. not ready The token index is still warming up. Counted from factory records only. It cannot see a push the owner makes by hand, or an owner wait set on a task that was already blocked. Cost and tokens per merged PR Not ready: the token index is still warming up. 2 tasks open now (in progress or in review), 3 agents working on a task.
